toolDefinitions.name: contacts-search
toolDefinitions.description: Find contacts by words in the name, organisation, phone number, email address, address or notes. Every word must match; accents and case do not matter, and a phone number matches however it is spaced. Gives a short card for each match: use contact-get for the full contact.

query.description: Words to look for in a name, organisation, phone number, email address, address or notes. Every word must match. Empty lists everyone.

toolDefinitions.name: contact-get
toolDefinitions.description: Read one contact in full: organisation, all phones and emails with their labels, birthday, address and notes.

id.description: ID of the contact, as returned by contacts-search.

toolDefinitions.name: contact-create
toolDefinitions.description: Add a contact to the address book at once. Needs a name. Give only what the person said; do not invent a phone number, an email or a birthday.

name.description: Full name as the person said it, for example Marco Rossi.

phones.description: All phone numbers of the contact, each with an optional label. On an update the list replaces the old one, so send every number to keep.

label.description: Free label such as mobile, home or work.

value.description: Phone number as written, for example +39 02 5550123.

emails.description: All email addresses of the contact, each with an optional label. On an update the list replaces the old one, so send every address to keep.

label.description: Free label such as mobile, home or work.

birthday.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or --MM-DD when the year is not known. An empty string takes it away.

address.description: Postal address as free text. An empty string takes it away.

toolDefinitions.name: contact-update
toolDefinitions.description: Change a contact at once. Give the id and only the fields that change. A phones or emails list replaces the whole list, so send the numbers or addresses to keep as well as the new one.

id.description: ID of the contact, as returned by contacts-search.

toolDefinitions.name: contact-delete
toolDefinitions.description: Delete a contact for good, at once. Look the contact up first and only delete what the person named.

id.description: ID of the contact, as returned by contacts-search.

description.en: Your agents look up and keep your address book: Marco's number, Anna's email, a birthday. It lives inside LocalAI, with no account to connect.
description.it: I tuoi agenti cercano e tengono la tua rubrica: il numero di Marco, l'email di Anna, un compleanno. Vive dentro LocalAI, senza nessun account da collegare.
description.de: Ihre Agenten suchen und führen Ihr Adressbuch: Marcos Nummer, Annas E-Mail, ein Geburtstag. Es lebt in LocalAI, ohne Konto, das verbunden werden muss.
description.es: Tus agentes buscan y llevan tu agenda de contactos: el número de Marco, el correo de Anna, un cumpleaños. Vive dentro de LocalAI, sin ninguna cuenta que conectar.
description.fr: Vos agents cherchent et tiennent votre carnet d'adresses : le numéro de Marco, l'e-mail d'Anna, un anniversaire. Il vit dans LocalAI, sans compte à connecter.
description.pt-BR: Seus agentes procuram e mantêm sua lista de contatos: o número do Marco, o e-mail da Anna, um aniversário. Ela vive dentro do LocalAI, sem nenhuma conta para conectar.
description.zh-CN: 你的智能体可以查找并维护你的通讯录：Marco 的电话、Anna 的邮箱、某人的生日。通讯录保存在 LocalAI 内部，无需连接任何账户。
description.ko: 에이전트가 주소록을 찾아보고 관리합니다. Marco의 전화번호, Anna의 이메일, 생일까지. 주소록은 LocalAI 안에 저장되며 연결할 계정이 필요 없습니다.
description.id: Agen Anda mencari dan mengelola buku alamat Anda: nomor Marco, email Anna, hari ulang tahun. Buku alamat ini tersimpan di dalam LocalAI, tanpa akun yang perlu dihubungkan.
